mentions.name: Definitive iOS music player
mentions.description: This iOS music player is designed to be a definitive player that works with every personal media server, in addition to local files and Apple Music libraries, and promises features no music player has ever done.
mentions.problem: Dissatisfaction with existing music players on iOS.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've never been satisfied with music players on iOS, so I'm making the definitive one. It works with every personal media server, in additional to local files and Apple Music libraries. It'll do some stuff that no music player has ever done.

evidence.value: I've never been satisfied with music players on iOS, so I'm making the definitive one. It works with every personal media server, in additional to local files and Apple Music libraries. It'll do some stuff that no music player has ever done.
